newsitem.title: UK: Legal gains in firm insurance sector.
newsitem.headline: Legal gains in firm insurance sector.

text.p: Shares in life assurer Legal & General Plc rose on Thursday as investors strove not to be underweight in the insurance sector, dealers said.
Dealers said the forthcoming June floation of Norwich Union has left investors chasing stock in the insurance sector to avoid falling behind with weightings.
Rebounding from a decline on Wednesday, Legal & General shares advanced 10-1/2p to 424-1/2p by 0849 GMT.
Separately Prudential Coporation Plc gained 5-1/2p to 606p with Lehman Brothers recommending the shares as a "buy" and reiterating a year-end price target of 700p.
Lehman said after a one-to-one with Prudential's group finance director Jonathan Bloomer that the insurer "will deliver superior returns to shareholders in the short and long-term."

Elsewhere in the sector, Commercial Union Plc rose 5p to 687-1/2p, General Accident Plc gained 6-1/2p to 886-1/2p, Guardian Royal Exchange shares rose 5-1/2p to 282p and Royal Sun Alliance were up 6-1/2p at 495p.
